title: Synch event catalogue v4.1.0
description: An event = envelope + type-specific payload. Producer schema: rejects unknown types and fields. Readers follow README.md 'Compatibility'. Meanings and spec citations: catalogue.md.

interrupted_state.description: T24 only: state the daemon found on restart.

within_scope.description: false iff scope_changes is non-empty; then a decision-02 operator decision is required before dispatch.

chunk.description: Normative cap: 65536 UTF-8 bytes (producer-enforced, catalogue.md 1.8). maxLength counts code points and is only an upper bound.

settled.description: true once host processes under the grant are confirmed stopped.

revoked_by.description: Authenticated operator identity that revoked the grant.

cause.description: thread_ended: daemon-caused end of the granted thread (dec. 14).

endpoint.description: Registered provider endpoint ID (one core manages heterogeneous endpoints).

resource.description: Existing VM ref, or for create_from_base the intended name carrying the request tag.

payload.description: Evidence fields are allowed only with their own via (vm-driver.md section 3 table). Each resolution admits only the vias that can establish it.

absence_lookup.description: Authoritative token lookup in the provider task API that found no task (platform must declare token lookup authoritative in its matrix row).
